fields_file.description: 채울 필드 JSON 파일의 절대 경로 — fields 대신. {"성명": "홍길동"} 모양(반복 양식은 값 배열). 값이 도구 인자로 대화에 남지 않고, 응답도 값 대신 글자 수만 낸다(mask_values: false 로 끔)

formats.description: 필드별 값 서식 (라벨 → 포맷). 정준값 하나로 서식마다 다른 모양을 채울 때: date:yy.mm.dd / phone:hyphen·dot·digits / rrn:hyphen·masked / mask:###-## / 자유 패턴(yyyy년 m월 d일, ###-####-####)

require_unique.description: 한 키가 서식의 2곳 이상에 매칭되면 채우지 않고 거부 — 반복 라벨 양식에서 남의 블록 오염 방지 (배열 값은 예외)

mask_values.description: 응답에 값 대신 글자수만 표시 — 개인정보 채움 시 값이 대화 로그에 남지 않게 (fields_file 이면 기본 켬)

output_format.description: 출력 포맷: hwpx-preserve (원본 스타일 보존, HWPX·HWP 5.x — HWP 는 서식 그대로 HWPX 로 바꿔 채움), hwpx (새 HWPX 생성), markdown

output_path.description: 출력 파일 저장 경로 (선택). 지정 시 파일로 저장, 미지정 시 텍스트로 반환

definition.name: generate_document
definition.description: 마크다운을 HWPX 한글 문서로 생성합니다(kordoc 공문서 서식). "보고서로/공문서로/개조식으로/계획서로 뽑아줘·만들어줘" 요청이 이 도구입니다. ⚠ 사용자가 견본 HWPX/HWP 를 주며 "이 서식대로·똑같이·이거처럼 써줘"라고 하면 이 도구가 아니라 parse_document → 내용만 새로 쓴 마크다운 → patch_document(견본 서식·로고·결재란·표 그대로, 문단 추가·삭제 가능)입니다 — 견본과 표·항목 구조가 다른 새 문서를 부서 서식으로 짤 때만 이 도구의 template_path. 프리셋 매핑: 정부 표준 보고서(표지·목차·로마숫자 장헤더 자동)='개조식', 중앙부처 업무보고·국회 서면보고(재경부 실측: 장 띠·절 숫자칸·소제목 박스·① 항목 띠·연노랑 성과 요약박스·별첨 띠, □ 뒤 (키워드) 파랑)='업무보고', 지방자치단체 방침서·추진계획(서울시 시장방침 실측: 제목표·파랑 부제·요약박스·[Ⅰ] 장 상자·절 띠)='서울방침' — 보고서·계획서를 만들 때 정부(업무보고)형과 지방(서울방침)형 중 무엇으로 할지 불명확하면 사용자에게 물어보세요, 기안문·시행문·알림공문='기안문', 1페이지 요약보고서='보고서', 추진계획='계획서'. 표는 실측 정부 서식(헤더 음영+이중선·외곽 굵은선·내용 비례 열폭), 쪽번호·결재란·'끝.' 표시 지원. ⚠ 생성 전 확인 권장: 문서종류(보고서/기안문)·제목·기관명(org)·날짜·목차 여부가 불명확하면 사용자에게 물어보세요 — 엉뚱한 프리셋 선택이 가장 흔한 오생성 원인. 마크다운 규칙(v4.13 서울 실결재 실측 위계): #(h1)=문서 제목, ##(h2)=장(보고서 Ⅰ Ⅱ / 기안문·통지는 법정 1.), ###(h3)=□ 대항목(기안문 가.), 그 아래 리스트=ㅇ → - → ㆍ(기안문 가. → 1) → 가)), 본문에 □/ㅇ/-/1./가. 를 직접 써도 같은 위계로 정규화, ※시작·'출처:'·'자료:'=참고(13pt), 제목 직후 인용문(>)=요약박스(보고서·계획서·개조식·서울방침 — 개조식은 표지(기본) 다음 본문 첫 쪽 제목 상자 아래·첫 장 앞 — cover:false 면 ※ 참고, 그 밖의 자리 인용문은 ※ 참고 / 업무보고는 `> ▪ …`=연노랑 성과 요약박스, 자리 무관) — ★내용 구성(보고서·계획서): 왜(추진배경·근거·현황 및 문제점) → 무엇을(추진개요·개선방안·세부 추진계획) → 어떻게(추진일정·소요예산·기대효과·향후계획)를 장 이름으로 — '서론·본론·결론'이라고 쓰지 말 것, 배경은 사실(지시 일자·법령 시행일·건수)로 열고 문제점마다 방안을 한 짝씩, 기대효과는 문제점 지표의 목표치, '결론적으로·만족도 향상·급변하는' 같은 AI 상투구 금지, 모르는 수치는 ○○ 자리표시. 결재용이면 gate: true(미통과면 지적 목록만 돌려줌 — 고쳐 쓰고 다시 호출). ★보고서·개조식은 반드시 제목 직후 `> …하고자 함` 한 문장(쉼표 허용·부호 없음·3줄 이내 약 90~100자)로 보고 목적을 넣을 것(3줄 초과·두 문장 이상이면 경고, 보고서·계획서·서울방침은 없어도 경고), <right>텍스트</right>=우측정렬. □·제목은 한 줄에 자동 축소, 본문은 어절 단위 줄바꿈(낱말·날짜가 줄 끝에서 안 쪼개짐)·부호 뒤 탭 정렬(둘째 줄이 첫 줄 내용과 같은 위치), 마지막 줄이 짧은 고아 줄과 공백이 크게 벌어지는 줄은 자간 축소로 정리, 곧은따옴표는 ‘’“”로. 법령 코드 (282791)·KOSIS 표 ID DT_…·(법정동코드 …)·○○ MCP 조회 같은 내부 식별자·도구 언급은 자동 제거 — 출처는 기관·자료명만 쓸 것. (원본 서식 보존 제자리 수정은 patch_document, 서식 빈칸 채우기는 fill_form)

markdown.description: HWPX로 변환할 마크다운 전문. 표는 GFM 문법 사용 (예: '| 이름 | 부서 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 홍길동 | 기획팀 |')

output_path.description: 출력 HWPX 파일의 절대 경로 (.hwpx 권장)

profile_path.description: 서식 프로필 JSON 경로 (extract_profile로 추출) — 참조 문서의 표 테두리·음영·열폭·셀 글꼴을 재현. 표 행·열 수와 첫 셀 텍스트가 일치하는 표에만 적용

template_path.description: 부서 서식 견본 HWPX 절대 경로 — 견본의 쪽 설정·글꼴·제목표·담당 줄(☎)·요약 상자(>)·□○-·※ 문단·데이터 표·참고N 띠 서식을 그대로 쓰고 내용만 markdown 으로 새로 짠다(견본 글은 남지 않음). 견본과 내용 구조가 달라도 된다 — 견본을 고쳐 쓰는(줄·칸 그대로) 일은 patch_document. preset·서식·쪽·image_dir·profile_path 와 함께 못 씀

pack_path.description: 기관팩(.kpack) 절대 경로 — build_agency_pack 으로 만든 그 기관 서식 묶음. template_path 대신 팩의 견본으로 생성(규칙·제약은 template_path 와 같음). 원고는 agency_pack_info 의 작성 요령대로 쓸 것

pack_kind.description: 기관팩 안 문서 종류 (기본: 종류가 하나면 그것, 여럿이면 report)

preset.description: 공문서 프리셋 — 지정 시 한국 행정 공문서 표준 서식 적용. '개조식'=정부 표준 개조식 보고서(표지·목차·로마숫자 장 헤더 자동 + □○-※ 부호별 폰트), '업무보고'=중앙부처 업무보고(##=Ⅰ 장 띠, ###=파란 숫자칸 절, ####=남색 소제목 박스, #####=① 하늘색 항목 띠, > ▪…=연노랑 성과 요약박스, ## 별첨 …=별첨 띠, ❶⇒ 부호 보존, 함초롬바탕 15·각주 맑은 고딕 12), '서울방침'=서울시 방침서(# 제목 뒤 '- 부제 -' 줄=파랑 부제·☎ 줄=담당자 행·> =요약박스, ##=[Ⅰ] 장 상자, ###=파란 번호 절 띠, ####=❶ 과제 소제목, □ HY견고딕 17·ㅇ 한컴돋움 15 굵게·- 휴먼명조 14·▸ 13, 줄간격 200%), '보도자료'=머리박스+제목 25pt+□→ㅇ→*(각주) 체계. 미지정 시 범용 마크다운 변환

font.description: 본문 글꼴(공문서 모드): myeongjo=명조 계열(개조식·보고서·계획서는 실측 휴먼명조, 그 외 함초롬바탕), gothic=맑은 고딕

body_pt.description: 본문 글자 크기(pt, 공문서 모드). 기본: 기안문 12, 보고서·계획서·통지 15

line_spacing.description: 본문 줄간격(%, 공문서 모드). 기본: 프리셋별 실측값(기안문 160, 회의록 130 등)

org.description: 표지 기관명 (표지를 켜는 모든 프리셋에서 사용 가능). 미지정 시 표지에 기관명 생략

date.description: 표지 날짜 ('YYYY. M. D.' 표기 권장). 미지정 시 오늘 날짜

toc.description: 목차 페이지 생성 여부 — h2 목록을 Ⅰ Ⅱ Ⅲ 장으로 자동 구성. 전 프리셋 사용 가능(보도자료 제외). 미지정 시 개조식 프리셋만 켜짐

cover.description: 표지 페이지 생성 여부 — 첫 h1을 제목으로 파랑 장식 표지. 전 프리셋 사용 가능(보도자료 제외 — 머리박스 서식과 양립 불가). 미지정 시 개조식 프리셋만 켜짐 (org/date 지정 시 자동 켜짐)

approval.description: 결재란 직위 라벨 (최대 6개, 예: ['담당','팀장','과장']) — 문서 최상단 우측에 서명 공란 결재 표 생성

page_numbers.description: 쪽번호(하단 중앙 '- 1 -', 표지·목차 카운트 제외). 미지정 시 개조식·보고서·계획서 켜짐

end_mark.description: 본문 끝 '끝.' 표시 (행정업무규정). 미지정 시 기안문만 켜짐, 본문이 이미 '끝.'으로 끝나면 중복 생성 안 함

body_title_box.description: 본문 첫 페이지 제목 반복 박스 (개조식 실측 관행). 미지정 시 개조식+표지 조합에서 켜짐

chapter_fit.description: 개조식 장 헤더 제목 칸을 글자 폭에 맞춤. 미지정 시 제목 칸이 본문 폭까지

h2_marker.description: h2 장 제목 표기: band=로마자 채움 칸+제목 띠 표(보고서·계획서 기본), roman='Ⅰ. 제목' 텍스트, number='1. 제목'(통지 기본), box=장 없이 □ 대항목으로, none=번호 없음. 기안문 본문의 h2는 항상 법정 '1.' 항목

band_color.description: 띠 제목 번호칸 채움색 #RRGGBB (기본 #003366 실측 최다. 교육청형 밝은 띠는 #DFE6F7 + band_text_color #000000)

summary.description: 요약 박스(보고서·계획서·개조식·서울방침) — 제목표(개조식은 본문 첫 쪽 제목 상자) 아래 #DFE6F7 음영 상자(서울 실결재 관행). 마크다운 제목 직후 인용문(> …)으로도 지정 가능

checklist.description: 서울 사전 검토항목 점검표(표지 다음 쪽, 보고서·계획서·서울방침) — true=표시 없는 빈 서식, {na:[6,7,…]}=적은 문항(1~14)은 해당없음·나머지 검토완료, notes={"7":"교육"}=비고

cover_label.description: 표지 우상단 취급 표시 — '대외주의'·'비공개' 빨간 테두리 박스 (업무보고 프리셋 실측, cover와 함께)

fonts.description: 요소별 글꼴 오버라이드(공문서 모드) — body=본문(○·-)/heading=제목 계열(□·장헤더·표지·목차)/ref=※ 참고/table=표 셀. 개조식·보고서·계획서는 네 역할 전부, 그 외 프리셋은 body만 적용

sizes.description: 개조식 요소별 글자 크기(pt) 오버라이드 — dae=□/cham=※/chapter=장헤더/coverTitle·coverSub=표지/tocLabel·tocRoman·tocItem=목차/table=표 셀/bodyTitle=본문 첫 페이지 제목 반복 박스. 미지정 요소는 body_pt 비례 기본값

levels.description: 항목부호 단계별 위계 타이포(공문서 모드, v4.12.3) — {"0":{font:"HY견고딕",pt:17,bold:true},"1":{font:"한컴돋움",bold:true}} 꼴(depth 0~7). 실측: 전자결재 기안문 □/ㅇ/- 계열은 □=HY견고딕 +2~3pt 굵게·ㅇ=한컴돋움 굵게·-=휴먼명조 본문. 법정 8단계(1. 가.)는 본문 동일이 관행이라 기본 미적용

bullet2.description: 2단계 항목부호 — 'ㅇ'(이응, 전자결재 기안문·공고문 실측 지배) / '○'(원, 보고서 양식) / '◦'·'❍'(일부 중앙부처). 미지정 시 통지·보도자료 ㅇ, 그 외 ○

agency.description: 기관 서식 — 중앙행정기관 이름 또는 '공통'(기관 간 최빈값). 정책브리핑 보도자료 2,670건 실측으로 그 기관의 □·ㅇ·- 글꼴·크기, 2단계 부호, 표 머리, 기관 색을 기본값으로 깐다(명시 옵션이 우선). 보고서·계획서·업무보고·개조식·보도자료 전용

total_row.description: 표 합계·총계·계 행 위치: top=머리행 바로 아래(기본, 공문 실무 관행) | bottom=맨 아래 | keep=원고 그대로. GFM 표에만 적용

suppress_single.description: 단일 형제 항목 부호 생략(편람 규정, 법정 번호 standard 전용 — 불릿 체계인 보고서·계획서·개조식·보도자료엔 무효). 기본 false — 하나뿐인 항목에도 부호(1. 가.)를 부여 (부호 없는 계단 들여쓰기가 실무 눈에 어색)

doc_head.description: 기안문 두문표(별지 제1호서식·서울 실결재 6행 표) — org=행정기관명(굴림 20pt bold 자간띄움)/slogan=원훈(상단 10pt)/to=수신('내부결재'면 발신명의 생략)/via=경유/title=제목(미지정 시 첫 h1). 기안문 프리셋 전용

doc_foot.description: 기안문 결문표 — sender=발신명의(18pt bold 중앙)/drafter·reviewer·approver='직위 성명' 결재선/cooperator=협조자/recipients=수신자 목록/docNum=시행 '과-번호 (날짜)'/receive=접수/zip·address·site/phone·fax·email/disclosure=공개구분. 기안문 프리셋 전용

report_info.description: 보고서: 제목표 아래 담당자 행 '(2026. 9. 6., 스마트도시과 홍길동, ☎450-1234)' / 기안문: 우상단 12pt 보고정보 행

notice_head.description: 공고문 두문·결문 — no=공고번호(본문 위 bold)/date=날짜(본문 아래 우측)/sender=발신명의(우측 bold). 통지 프리셋 전용

press.description: 보도자료 옵션 — release=보도시점/distribute=배포일(머리박스)/sub=부제 배열('- … -')/contact=담당 표: dept=담당 부서, people=[{role:'책임자',title:'과장',name:'이○○',phone:'044-000-0000'},{role:'담당자',…}] 사람마다 한 행(실물 보도자료 꼴). people 없으면 manager·phone 한 행

header.description: 머리말 텍스트 — 모든 쪽 상단, 인라인 마크다운 허용 (v4.5.0)

image_dir.description: 마크다운 이미지 참조(![](x.png))를 이 디렉토리에서 읽어 실데이터 임베드 (v4.5.0, PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP). 미지정 시 참조만 placeholder로 보존

inline_math.description: 본문·표 셀의 인라인 수식 $…$ 를 한글 수식 개체로 생성 (블록 $$…$$ 는 늘 수식). 미지정 시 글자 그대로 — 가격 표기 같은 일반 $ 오인 방지. 켜도 짝이 맞는 $…$ 만(공백으로 시작·끝나거나 \$ 이스케이프면 제외)

gate.description: 공문서 게이트 — 표기법·문체 error 와 윤문(생성형 AI 문체)·구성(왜→무엇→어떻게, 문제점↔방안 짝, 배경 사실·기대효과 목표치) 지적이 하나라도 있으면 파일을 만들지 않고 지적 목록을 돌려준다. 결재용 원고는 켜고, 지적을 고쳐 쓴 뒤 다시 호출

definition.name: lint_document
definition.description: 공문서 검수 — 표기법(날짜·시각·금액·붙임·외래어·쉬운 말·차별 표현)은 늘, 개조식 문체·윤문·구성·본문↔표 수치·예산(산출근거 검산·표 합계·합계 행 위치·외화 표기·증감 기준)은 골라 켭니다. text(마크다운·평문, 한 줄 = 한 문단) 또는 file_path(HWP·HWPX·PDF 등) 중 하나. 결과 JSON 의 지적마다 line(1부터)·column(1부터, 문서 단위 지적엔 없음)·match·rule·severity·message·suggest — 열린 문서를 고치는 도구는 blocks(문단·표 칸마다 id·글·표 위치)로 넘기면 지적마다 block(id)·offset(블록 안 위치, 0부터)·length 로 돌려받습니다.

text.description: 검수할 글(마크다운·평문). file_path 와 둘 중 하나

file_path.description: 검수할 문서 파일의 절대 경로(HWP·HWPX·PDF·DOCX 등). text·blocks 와 셋 중 하나

blocks.description: 문서 순서대로 문단·표 칸 블록 — 표 칸은 table{id,row,col}(같은 id 칸이 한 표). 결과 지적은 block·offset·length. text·file_path 와 셋 중 하나

numbers.description: 본문 수치 ↔ 표 수치 대조(확인 목록)

budget.description: 예산 문서 검수 — 산출근거 곱셈 검산, 표 합계 재계산·합계 행 위치(머리행 바로 아래), 외화(원화 먼저·환율 기준), 증감 기준(본예산/최종예산)

gate.description: 결재 전 게이트 — 표기법·문체 error 와 윤문·구성 지적이 있으면 summary.ok=false

preset.description: 게이트 범위를 맞출 프리셋(보고서·계획서·개조식 등, 한글 별칭 가능)

definition.name: parse_chunks
definition.description: 문서를 RAG용 구조 청크 JSON으로 파싱합니다. 헤딩·개조식 위계(□○- / 1.·가.·1))가 breadcrumb 경로로 보존되고 표는 독립 청크로 나옵니다 — 임베딩·인덱싱 전처리용. 자르기(토큰 상한·오버랩)는 소비자 몫입니다.

file_path.description: 대상 문서의 절대 경로 (HWP/HWPX/PDF/XLSX/DOCX)

granularity.description: section=같은 breadcrumb 아래 연속 텍스트 병합(기본), block=IRBlock 1개=청크 1개

include_table_cells.description: 표 청크에 셀 텍스트 2차원 배열 포함 여부

definition.name: parse_document
definition.description: 한국 문서 파일(HWP, HWPX, PDF, XLSX, DOCX)과 이미지(PNG/JPG/WebP)를 마크다운으로 변환합니다. 파일 경로를 입력하면 포맷을 자동 감지하여 텍스트를 추출합니다. 이미지는 OCR(내장 PP-OCRv5)이 자동 적용되고 표 괘선도 복원됩니다. 견본 서식대로 새 문서를 쓰거나(서식 베끼기) 문구를 고쳐 patch_document 로 넘길 마크다운이면 keep_layout_tables: true 로 읽으세요.

file_path.description: 파싱할 문서 파일의 절대 경로 (HWP, HWPX, PDF, XLSX, DOCX, PNG/JPG/WebP)

ocr.description: 스캔/이미지 PDF 텍스트 OCR (내장 PP-OCRv5 korean, 첫 사용 시 ~18MB 자동 다운로드). true=텍스트층이 없거나 깨진 페이지만 인식하고 정상 페이지는 그대로 둡니다. "force"=텍스트층이 있어도 무시하고 전 페이지 강제 재인식. parse 결과에 NEEDS_OCR 경고가 있으면 이 옵션으로 재시도하세요

remove_header_footer.description: PDF 머리글/바닥글 자동 제거 (기본 true — false로 끄기, CLI --no-header-footer 대응)

formula_ocr.description: PDF 수식 OCR 활성화 (MFD+MFR ONNX, 첫 사용 시 모델 ~155MB 자동 다운로드, CLI --formula-ocr 대응)

ocr_rec.description: OCR 글자 인식 모델 — "handwriting": 수기 서류용 한국어 손글씨 rec(첫 사용 시 ~15MB 다운로드). 손글씨 칸이 많은 서식용이며 금액·날짜·전화번호의 쉼표·마침표·하이픈을 빠뜨리는 경우가 있다. "auto": 기본보다 너그러운 문턱으로 확신도 낮은 손글씨 쪽을 손글씨 rec 로 다시 읽는다(인쇄·손글씨 섞인 묶음용 — 기본도 뚜렷한 손글씨 쪽은 손글씨 rec 로 바꾼다). "printed": 기본 rec 만(손글씨 rec 를 받지도 쓰지도 않는다). OCR 이 도는 곳(이미지, PDF 는 ocr: true·"force" — ocr 을 빼면 고른 모델이 캐시에 있을 때만 자동 OCR)에 적용 (CLI --ocr-rec 대응)

ocr_det.description: OCR 글줄 검출 모델 — "mobile"(기본) | "server"(첫 사용 시 ~88MB 다운로드) | "medium"(PP-OCRv6, 첫 사용 시 ~62MB 다운로드 — 기울임·흐림·스캔 같은 열화 입력용) (CLI --ocr-det 대응)

ocr_det_long_side.description: OCR 글줄 검출 입력 긴 변 픽셀 (32~4096, 기본 960) — 키우면 작은 글씨를 더 잡고 느려진다 (CLI --ocr-det-long-side 대응)

dedupe_running_headers.description: HWP5 레이아웃 표 페이지 반복 러닝 헤더 중복 제거 (기본 off — 붙임별 재번호 오삭제 주의, CLI --dedupe-headers 대응)

keep_trailing_empty_cols.description: 표 오른쪽 끝 빈 열(서식 입력란) 보존 (#47, 기본 off: 후행 빈 열 트림, CLI --keep-empty-cols 대응)

keep_empty_paragraphs.description: 빈 문단 보존 — 본문은 빈 paragraph 블록, 표 셀은 빈 줄 (#57, 기본 off, CLI --keep-empty-paragraphs 대응)

include_field_placeholders.description: 미기입 누름틀 안내문도 출력 — 빈 서식 문서의 칸 용도 보존 (#92, 기본 off, CLI --include-field-placeholders 대응)

memos.description: 메모(한글 "메모 넣기")를 문서 끝 "메모" 절로 — 작성자·시각·붙은 글·메모 글 (#180, HWPX·HWP5, 기본 off, CLI --memos 대응). 메모가 있으면 끄더라도 머리 줄에 개수를 알린다

keep_layout_tables.description: 테두리가 안 보이는 틀 표도 원본 표 구조 그대로 (기본 off = 보이는 대로: 틀은 글, 칸으로 조립한 분수는 수식). patch_document 로 되돌릴 편집본은 켜서 뽑는다 (CLI --keep-layout-tables)

html_tables.description: 모든 표를 HTML 로 — 파이프 표도 HTML 표로, 태그마다 한 줄씩 들여써 냄 (기본 off, CLI --html-tables 대응)

table_format.description: "gfm": 모든 표를 HTML 없이 GFM 파이프 표로 — 셀 안 표는 부모 뒤 독립 표로 꺼내고 관계를 <!-- <table id parent_id /> --> 표지로 남김 (RAG 색인용, html_tables 와 함께 못 씀, CLI --table-format 대응)

script_tags.description: 위·아래첨자를 <sup>·<sub> 로 표기("10⁴ m²" 가 "104 m2" 로 펴지지 않게) — 기본: HWPX·HWP·DOCX 켬, PDF 끔(논문·수식 PDF 는 true 권장), false 면 모두 평문. CLI --script-tags / --no-script-tags 대응

plain.description: 평문 Markdown — 그림 자리 표시·링크 URL·밑줄/굵게 표기를 빼고 글만 (제목·목록·표 구조는 유지, 기본 off, CLI --plain 대응)

password.description: 암호로 보호된 문서의 열기 암호 (#59, HWPX·HWP3·HWP5 지원. 파싱이 ENCRYPTED로 실패하면 이 옵션으로 재시도하세요. 한컴 DRM 보호 문서는 해당 없음)

tables.description: PDF 표 감지 (기본 true — false로 끄기, CLI --no-tables 대응). 테두리 박스를 표로 오인해 읽기 순서가 뒤집히는 문서(2단 시험지 등)에서 자연 읽기순 텍스트만 뽑습니다 (#64)

definition.name: parse_form
definition.description: 한국 서식 문서에서 레이블-값 쌍을 구조화된 JSON으로 추출합니다. 양식/서식 문서에 최적화.

file_path.description: 서식 문서 파일의 절대 경로

definition.name: parse_metadata
definition.description: 문서의 메타데이터(제목, 작성자, 날짜 등)만 빠르게 추출합니다. 전체 파싱 없이 헤더/매니페스트만 읽습니다.

file_path.description: 메타데이터를 추출할 문서 파일의 절대 경로

definition.name: parse_pages
definition.description: 문서의 특정 페이지 범위만 파싱합니다. PDF와 한컴 저장본 HWP/HWPX는 실제 페이지 기준(metadata.pageMode=layout), 조판 캐시가 없는 생성 파일은 섹션 단위 근사(pageMode=section)입니다.

file_path.description: 파싱할 문서 파일의 절대 경로

definition.name: parse_table
definition.description: 문서에서 N번째 테이블만 추출합니다 (0-based index). 테이블이 없거나 인덱스 범위를 초과하면 오류를 반환합니다.

file_path.description: 파싱할 문서 파일의 절대 경로

definition.name: patch_document
definition.description: 원본 HWPX/HWP의 서식(글꼴·표·도장칸·로고·결재란·이미지)을 그대로 두고, 편집된 마크다운대로 글을 바꿔 새 문서로 출력합니다. 두 가지 용도: (1) 문구 수정·빈칸 채우기, (2) ★서식 베끼기 — "이 문서 서식대로/똑같은 양식으로/이거 참고해서 ○○ 문서 써줘"처럼 견본의 분위기를 그대로 재현해 새 공문서를 쓰는 요청. 절차: parse_document(견본, keep_layout_tables: true) → 받은 마크다운의 골격(표지·결재란 표, 제목, □·ㅇ·- 부호와 들여쓰기, 강조 표지 **, 표 표기)을 유지한 채 내용만 새로 쓰기 → 이 도구(file_path=견본, output_path=새 파일) → render_document 로 확인. HWPX 견본은 문단을 자유롭게 늘리고 줄여도 됩니다: 새 줄은 같은 항목 부호(□·ㅇ·-·※·1.·가.)를 단 견본 문단을 복제해 같은 들여쓰기·글꼴·굵기로 들어가고, 지운 줄은 문단째 빠집니다. 표는 견본 표를 그대로 두고 칸 글만 바꾸며 행은 추가·삭제(<table> 표기면 그 HTML 꼴 유지, GFM 으로 바꾸지 말 것). 견본에 없는 요소를 새로 만들거나 kordoc 기본 서식으로 다시 짜는 generate_document 는 서식 베끼기에 쓰지 마세요. HWP(5.x) 견본은 제자리 수정에서 문단 추가·삭제가 안 됩니다 — 줄 수가 바뀌면 원본을 서식 그대로 HWPX 로 바꿔 반영한 대체본(<출력>.rewrite.hwpx)을 받습니다(HWP 결과가 꼭 필요하면 줄 수를 견본에 맞추세요). 좌표가 어긋난 자리(틀 표·제목 상자·강제 줄바꿈 문단 등)는 원문 글을 찾아 그 자리만 고치고, 그래도 제자리 반영 못 한 편집이 있으면 편집 내용을 다 담은 대체본(원본 서식으로 새로 쓴 <출력>.rewrite.hwpx)을 함께 만듭니다 — 서식을 맞추려고 칸을 비우거나 내용을 빼지 말고 넣을 내용을 그대로 쓰세요.

file_path.description: 원본 문서의 절대 경로 (HWPX 또는 HWP 5.x)

edited_markdown.description: parse_document(keep_layout_tables: true) 출력 마크다운을 편집한 전체 마크다운. 문단 사이는 빈 줄, 줄마다 견본과 같은 항목 부호로 시작(부호가 서식 견본을 고른다). HWPX 는 문단 추가·삭제 반영(HWP 는 대체본에), 블록 순서 바꾸기는 미지원. 견본의 이미지 줄· 는 그대로 둘 것

output_path.description: 출력 파일 저장 절대 경로 (원본과 같은 확장자: .hwpx 또는 .hwp)

structure.description: 문단 추가·삭제 반영 (HWPX, 기본 true). false 면 추가·삭제를 건너뛰고 미적용으로 보고 — 글 수정만 하고 문서 골격을 절대 바꾸지 않을 때

definition.name: place_seal
definition.description: 도장/서명 이미지를 앵커 문구("(인)"·"서명 또는 인" 등) 위에 부유(글 앞) 배치합니다. 표/페이지를 키우지 않습니다 (HWPX·HWP 5.x — HWP 는 서식 그대로 HWPX 로 바꿔 찍어 HWPX 로 냅니다).

file_path.description: 대상 HWPX·HWP 문서의 절대 경로

image_path.description: 도장/서명 이미지 절대 경로 (투명 배경 PNG 권장)

anchor.description: 앵커 문구 — 이 문구 기준으로 배치

size_mm.description: 도장 한 변 크기 mm (기본: 줄높이×1.6, 7~18 클램프)

mode.description: overlap=문구 위 겹침, right=문구 오른쪽 옆, auto=공간 있으면 right

definition.name: redact_document
definition.description: 문서의 개인정보(주민·외국인등록번호·전화·이메일·카드·계좌·사업자등록번호·여권·운전면허, rules 로 인명·주소 opt-in)를 탐지해 서식 보존 마스킹합니다. HWPX/HWP는 원본 서식 그대로 같은 길이로 가린 파일 — 본문·표·중첩표·머리말/꼬리말·각주·글상자·필드·미리보기(텍스트·이미지)·문서 정보(제목·작성자)까지 가리고, 저장 전 결과 파일을 다시 훑어 남은 PII를 보고합니다. 그 외 포맷(PDF·DOCX·XLSX 등)은 원본을 건드리지 않고 마스킹된 마크다운만 출력합니다. 자동 검출 보조 도구 — 결과 리포트를 사람이 최종 확인해야 하며 이미지 속 글자는 탐지하지 못합니다. 마스킹 후 render_document로 눈으로 확인하는 것을 권장합니다.

file_path.description: 대상 문서의 절대 경로

rules.description: 적용 룰 (기본: rrn·phone·email·card·account·brn·passport·driver — crn(법인등록번호)·ip·name(인명, 문맥 게이트)·address(주소)는 opt-in)

output_path.description: 출력 경로 (HWPX/HWP는 같은 확장자, 그 외는 .md) — dry_run이 아니면 필수

definition.name: render_document
definition.description: HWPX·HWP 문서를 실제 조판 그대로 렌더해 PNG/JPEG 이미지로 응답하거나 SVG·HTML·PDF 파일로 저장합니다. generate_document·fill_form·patch_document·place_seal 결과물을 눈으로 확인하는 용도 — 생성/수정 후 이 도구로 렌더해 깨짐·잘림·배치를 검증하고 다시 고치는 루프를 권장합니다. 한컴 저장본(HWPX·HWP 모두)은 조판 캐시로 정확히, AI 생성본(캐시 없음)은 순수 조판 엔진(reflow)으로 렌더되며 후자는 한컴 실조판의 근사입니다 (참고용 미리보기).

file_path.description: 렌더할 HWPX 또는 HWP(5.x) 파일의 절대 경로

format.description: png/jpeg=이미지로 응답에 직접 반환(output_path 는 선택) / svg·html·pdf=output_path 에 파일 저장(필수). svg 는 pages 미지정 HWPX 면 전체 세로 스택 1파일, 그 외 페이지별 파일. html=자급자족 레이아웃 HTML 1파일, pdf=Chromium 필요

output_path.description: 결과 저장 경로 (확장자는 format 과 일치 — .png/.jpg/.svg/.html/.pdf). 페이지별 산출은 _page_NNN 접미

highlights.description: 형광펜 표시할 검색어 목록 — 채운 값·수정 문구 위치 확인용

reflow_mode.description: reflow 줄바꿈: keep=어절 단위, charAll=글자 단위

pages.description: 페이지 선택(1-based: '3', '1-3', '1,3,7-9') — 지정하면 페이지별 산출(이미지 응답은 최대 8쪽). HWPX png/svg 에서 미지정이면 전체를 세로 스택 1장으로

max_width_px.description: 래스터(png/jpeg) 최대 폭 px — 큰 문서 응답 부피 조절

password.description: 암호로 보호된 HWPX·HWP 의 열기 암호 (렌더가 암호 안내로 실패하면 이 옵션으로 재시도하세요. 배포용·한컴 DRM 문서는 해당 없음)

definition.name: discover_tools
definition.title: 전문 도구 찾기
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [메타] 전문도구(조세심판·관세·헌재·행심·공정위·개인정보위·노동위·학칙·조약·영문법령·용어 등 80+개) 카테고리 검색. 도구 이름과 설명을 돌려준다

intent.description: 찾고 싶은 도구의 의도 또는 카테고리 (예: '공정위', '조약', '용어', '헌재')

definition.name: execute_tool
definition.title: 전문 도구 실행
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [메타] 전문도구를 이름(tool_name)과 인자(params)로 실행

definition.name: get_annexes
definition.title: 별표·서식 조회
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [별표] 별표/서식 조회. lawName+'별표N'으로 내용 추출. 금액/기준은 별표에 있는 경우 많음. date(기준일)를 주면 그날 시행 중이던 버전의 별표 — 건축허가·착공·처분 시점의 설치기준·과태료표 등 과거 기준이 필요할 때(제명이 바뀐 법령도 옛 버전까지, 별표 번호가 시점마다 달라 query로 별표명을 주는 편이 안전).

lawName.description: 법령명 (예: '관세법'). 별표를 바로 지정하려면 '... 별표4' 또는 '... 별표1의2'처럼 함께 입력 가능

bylSeq.description: 별표번호 (예: '000300'). 지정 시 해당 별표 파일을 다운로드하여 텍스트로 추출

query.description: 별표명으로 좁히기 (예: '운전면허 취소·정지', '과태료'). 번호를 모를 때 사용. 1건으로 좁혀지면 그 별표 본문을 바로 추출

jo.description: 위임 조문 (예: '제38조', '38'). 조문 동반 질의('관세법 제38조 별표2')의 조문 맥락 — 별표명의 '(제38조 관련)' 표기와 대조해 좁히고, 응답에 위임 관계를 표기

date.description: 기준일 (예: '2015-06-01'). 지정 시 그날 시행 중이던 법령 버전의 별표를 조회 — 건축허가·착공·처분·위반 시점 기준이 필요할 때. 제명이 바뀐 법령도 옛 버전까지 찾는다. 별표 번호는 시점마다 다를 수 있으니 query(별표명)로 좁히는 것이 안전. 미지정 시 현행

definition.name: get_decision_text
definition.title: 판례·결정례 본문 조회
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [통합조회] 23개 도메인 전문 조회. domain+id. full=false(기본) 시 본문 계단식 축약

id.description: 일련번호/ID (search 결과에서 획득. nts·ministry=moef는 본문조회ID(ntstDcmId))

full.description: true=본문 전문 그대로. 미지정=이유/전문 섹션 계단식 축약 (판시·요지·주문은 항상 full)

options.description: 도메인별 옵션. treaty:{chrClsCd:'010202'(한)/'010203'(영)} english_law:{mst,lawName} ministry:{ministry(search 때와 같은 부처)} prec/constitutional/admin_appeal/interpretation:{caseName}

definition.name: get_law_text
definition.title: 법령 조문 조회
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [법령조회] 조문 전문 조회. mst/lawId 필수, jo로 특정 조문만 가능 — jo는 '제148조의2' 같은 자연어 조문 표기를 그대로 받는다(권장). 6자리 JO 코드를 직접 쓰려면 조번호 4자리 zero-pad + 의X 2자리: 제10조의2→001002, 제234조의2→023402(234002 아님). jo='부칙' 이면 부칙 원문(시행일·경과조치, 최근 공포부터). 과거 시점 본문은 efYd 에 그 날짜를 넣으면 그날 시행 중이던 버전으로 자동 보정한다(제명이 바뀌기 전 버전 포함).

jo.description: 조문 번호. 자연어 표기 권장 — '제38조'·'제148조의2'를 그대로 넣으면 서버가 변환한다. 6자리 JO 코드 직접 지정 시 조번호 4자리 zero-pad + 의X 2자리: 제38조→003800, 제10조의2→001002, 제234조의2→023402(234002 아님). '부칙' 이면 부칙 원문(최근 공포부터)

efYd.description: 기준일 또는 시행일자 (YYYYMMDD). 시행일이면 그 버전, 시행일이 아닌 날짜(건축허가일·사건일 같은 조회 기준일)면 그날 시행 중이던 버전으로 자동 보정한다(제명이 바뀌기 전 버전 포함). 현행 본문은 efYd 없이 조회한다. 시행예정본은 그 시행일을 넣는다.

definition.name: legal_analysis
definition.title: 인용 검증·법령 분석·신구조문대비표
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [정밀분석] 검증·분석·신구조문대비표 5종 통합. mode: verify_citations=텍스트 속 법령 조문·판례 인용('민법 제750조', '대법원 2013다61381' 등)이 실존하는지 법제처 DB 교차검증, LLM 환각 방지 — 판례는 실존불가/미확인 구분(text 필수) | cite_check=판례 생사 확인 — 사건번호로 후속 인용 역추적+변경·폐기 감지, 한국형 Citator(caseNumber 필수) | applicable_law=사건 시점에 시행되던 법령 버전+그 시점 조문+부칙 경과조치, 행위시법 판단(lawName+date 필수, jo 선택). 제명이 바뀐 법령은 옛 이름 시절 버전으로 특정. 법령이 아니면 행정규칙(고시·훈령 — 예: '스프링클러설비의 화재안전기준', 'NFTC 103')의 기준일 시행 버전 | impact_map=한 조문을 인용한 판례·헌재·해석례·행심·조례 역방향 그래프+mermaid(lawName+jo 필수, jo는 '제103조'·'103조'·JO 6자리 코드 '010300' 모두 수용) | amendment_table=일부개정안의 신구조문대비표(신·구조문대비표·신구대비표·개정안 대비표) 작성 — 개정 후 조문만 주면 현행 조문을 법제처에서 가져와 법제처 대비표 표기 그대로 대조: 바뀐 부분 밑줄(채팅 표에서는 굵은 글씨), 개정안 칸의 같은 부분 '----'(글자 수만큼, 문장 끝 마침표 유지), 같은 항·호 '①·② (생  략)'/'(현행과 같음)' 묶음, <신  설>·<삭  제>·<단서 신설>. 줄표 수·묶음·밑줄 범위를 규칙대로 계산한 결과라 표를 그대로 쓸 수 있다(lawName+amendments 필수, 조례·행정규칙은 amendments[].currentText). 로컬 실행에서는 outputPath 로 한글(.hwpx) 저장

mode.description: 분석 유형 (도구 설명의 mode 표 참조)

text.description: [verify_citations 필수] 검증할 법률 텍스트 (LLM 답변/계약서 등 조문 인용 포함 문자열)

lawName.description: [applicable_law·impact_map·amendment_table 필수] 법령명 (예: '민법', '도로교통법'). applicable_law는 약칭·옛 법령명과 행정규칙명(고시 — 예: '스프링클러설비의 화재안전기준', 'NFTC 103')도 받는다. amendment_table은 조례·행정규칙이면 amendments[].currentText 로 현행 원문을 같이 준다

jo.description: [impact_map 필수, applicable_law 선택] 조문 번호 — 자연어 표기('제103조', '제10조의2')와 6자리 JO 코드('010300', '001002') 모두 수용

maxCitations.description: [verify_citations] 검증할 최대 인용 개수 (기본 15, 많을수록 느림)

display.description: [cite_check] 후속 인용 판례 최대 표시 수 (기본 20)

deepScan.description: [cite_check] 후속 인용 상위 판례 본문 정밀 스캔 (기본 true, false면 빠르지만 변경·폐기 감지 생략)

includeOrdinances.description: [impact_map] 자치법규 인용 검색 포함 (기본 true, false면 전국 조례 팬아웃 생략)

amendments.description: [amendment_table 필수] 신구조문대비표를 만들 개정 조문 목록

jo.description: 조문 번호 (예: '제22조'). 생략 시 text 첫머리의 조 번호

text.description: 개정 후 조문 — 조 머리부터, 한 줄에 항·호·목 하나. 안 바뀌는 항·호는 '② ∼ ⑤ (현행과 같음)'·'1.·2. (현행과 같음)'으로 줄여 쓴다(적지 않은 현행 항·호는 삭제로 본다). 지우는 항은 '③ 삭제', 조 전체 삭제는 '제5조 삭제'

currentText.description: 현행 조문 원문 직접 입력(조례·행정규칙·미공포안). 신설 조는 빈 문자열

title.description: [amendment_table] 대비표 제목 (예: '건축법 일부개정법률안'). 생략 시 법령명으로 만든다

definition.name: legal_research
definition.title: 법령 종합 리서치
definition.description: Korean-law-mcp — [⛓리서치] 다단계 법령 리서치 통합 — 여러 API를 병렬로 엮는 복합 질문 전용. task: full_research=도메인·법령명 불명확한 자연어 질문 폴백(기본값, 예 '음주운전 처벌 기준') | law_system=법률·시행령·시행규칙 3단+위임+별표(예 '관세법 체계') | action_basis=처분·허가의 법적 근거+해석례+판례+행심(예 '영업정지 근거') | dispute_prep=불복·소송 준비, 판례+심판례+도메인 결정례(예 '과세처분 불복') | amendment_track=개정 이력+신구대조+연혁(예 '2023년 개정 뭐 바뀜') | ordinance_compare=조례 전국 비교+상위법 적합성(예 '서울시 주차 조례') | procedure_detail=절차·수수료·별표서식(예 '건축허가 절차') | document_review=계약서·약관 조항 리스크+근거법령(text 필수). scenario(선택): 확장 시나리오 — time_travel(두 시점 본문 diff)·timeline·penalty·action_plan·delegation·impact·compliance·customs·manual. 미지정 시 쿼리에서 자동 감지되며, task별 호환 조합은 scenario 파라미터 설명 참조.

query.description: 자연어 질문/법령명/키워드 (예: '음주운전 처벌 기준', '관세법 체계'). document_review 외 모든 task에서 필수

definition.name: search_analytics
definition.description:
Query Google Search Console search performance data (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) with filtering and grouping.

DIMENSIONS: query, page, country, device, date, searchAppearance, hour
- "hour" requires data_state="hourly_all" and is limited to the last 10 days
- "searchAppearance" CANNOT be combined with "query" or "page" (API restriction)

TYPE: web (default), image, video, news, discover, googleNews
- "discover" = Google Discover feed. "googleNews" = Google News tab (distinct from "news")

DATA STATE: Controls data freshness.
- "all" (default) includes recent incomplete data matching the GSC dashboard
- "final" returns only confirmed data with a 2-3 day lag, useful for stable reporting
- "hourly_all" enables hourly granularity but data may be incomplete for the current day

BRAND FILTER: Set to "brand_only" or "non_brand_only" to auto-filter queries by your domain name.

Country codes use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format (e.g., 'usa', 'gbr', 'deu') — NOT alpha-2.

definition.name: searxng_web_search
definition.description: Searches the web using SearXNG and returns a list of results, each with a title, URL, and content snippet. CRITICAL: The required parameter name is exactly `query` (not `prompt`, `q`, or any other name). Calls an external SearXNG instance; availability depends on the `SEARXNG_URL` configuration. Use `pageno` to paginate results; combine `time_range` and `language` to narrow scope. When `engines` and `time_range` are both provided, every selected engine must explicitly advertise time-range support via SearXNG /config; otherwise the request is rejected before search. To read the full text of a result URL, follow up with `web_url_read`.

query.description: The search query string. This is the required parameter name — use exactly `query`, not `prompt` or `q`.

pages.description: Fetch 1 to 5 consecutive pages concurrently starting at pageno; merge and deduplicate before applying the result limit. Failed pages are reported in failedPages in JSON output.

time_range.description: Time range of search (day, week, month, year). With explicit engines, all selected engines must confirm time_range_support=true via /config.

language.description: Language code for search results (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de'). Default is instance-dependent.

safesearch.description: Safe search filter level (0: None, 1: Moderate, 2: Strict)

min_score.description: Minimum relevance score threshold from 0.0 to 1.0. Results below this score are filtered out.

num_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20). Operator cap SEARXNG_MAX_RESULTS applies as a ceiling.

categories.description: Comma-separated SearXNG categories. Live /config capabilities are aggregated across reachable instances; prefer searxng_instance_info categories.common for consistent multi-instance results. Values in categories.available are best-effort and may only be honored by some instances. Known values are normalized case-insensitively; unknown values are forwarded trimmed so SearXNG can ignore or honor them. If /config is unavailable, values are forwarded as-is with a warning. If omitted, each instance uses its server-side default.

engines.description: Comma-separated SearXNG engine names to query (e.g. 'google,bing,ddg'). Live /config capabilities are aggregated across reachable instances; prefer searxng_instance_info engines.common.enabled for consistent multi-instance results. Values in engines.available.enabled are best-effort and may only be honored by some instances. Known values are normalized case-insensitively; unknown values are forwarded trimmed so SearXNG can ignore or honor them. If /config is unavailable, values are forwarded as-is with a warning. If omitted, each instance uses its server-side default.

response_format.description: Response format: formatted text for agents or raw JSON for programmatic clients. If omitted, SEARXNG_DEFAULT_RESPONSE_FORMAT applies; if unset or invalid, text is used. An explicit response_format always takes precedence.

result_detail.description: Result detail: full preserves SearXNG metadata and search signals; compact returns only title, URL, and content-snippet fields for each result (JSON keys: title, url, content). If omitted, full is used.

definition.name: web_url_read
definition.description: Fetches a URL and returns readable content as markdown. Content-type aware: HTML is converted to markdown; JSON is pretty-printed; plain text, YAML, TOML, and XML are returned as fenced readable text. PDF text extraction is supported with bounded input, output, page count, time, concurrency, and memory; OCR is not supported. Binary, media, archive, and octet-stream downloads other than PDFs are intentionally rejected instead of being returned as raw bytes. When the operator configures browser solvers, mcp-searxng attempts FlareSolverr first and then Byparr only after a busy or transient-unavailable acquisition; cache hits bypass acquisition and a final busy or unavailable provider uses one uncached direct-fetch fallback. Three modes: (1) Full content — omit filtering params; use `startChar`/`maxLength` to paginate large pages. (2) Section extraction — set `section` to return content under a specific heading. (3) Headings only — set `readHeadings: true` to list all headings (mutually exclusive with other filtering params). Returns an error string if the URL is unreachable or content cannot be extracted. Use after `searxng_web_search` to read the full content of individual result URLs.

url.description: URL

startChar.description: Starting character position for content extraction (default: 0)

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters to return

section.description: Extract content under a specific heading (searches for heading text)

readHeadings.description: Return only a list of headings instead of full content

pipeline.description:
An array of aggregation stages to execute.

If the user has asked for a vector search, `$vectorSearch` **MUST** be the first stage
of the pipeline (or the first stage of a `$unionWith` sub-pipeline only when explicitly
combining unrelated result sets — for hybrid full-text + vector search, use `$rankFusion`
or `$scoreFusion` instead, see below).

If the user has asked for lexical/Atlas search, use `$search` instead of `$text`.
### Usage Rules for `$vectorSearch`
- **Index Type Detection:**
  Use the collection-indexes tool to determine if the target field has a classic vector index (type: 'vector') or an auto-embed index (type: 'autoEmbed').
- **Classic Vector Search (type: 'vector'):**
  Use 'queryVector' with embeddings as an array of numbers.
- **Auto-Embed Vector Search (type: 'autoEmbed'):**
  Use 'query' - MongoDB automatically generates embeddings at query time. Do NOT use 'queryVector' or 'embeddingParameters' for auto-embed indexes.
- **Unset embeddings:**
  Unless the user explicitly requests the embeddings, add an `$unset` stage **at the end of the pipeline** to remove the embedding field and avoid context limits. **The $unset stage in this situation is mandatory**.
- **Pre-filtering:**
  If the user requests additional filtering, include filters in `$vectorSearch.filter` only for pre-filter fields in the vector index.
  NEVER include fields in $vectorSearch.filter that are not part of the vector index.
- **Post-filtering:**
  For all remaining filters, add a $match stage after $vectorSearch.
- If unsure which fields are filterable, use the collection-indexes tool to determine valid prefilter fields.
- If no requested filters are valid prefilters, omit the filter key from $vectorSearch.

### Usage Rules for `$search`
- Include the index name, unless you know for a fact there's a default index. If unsure, use the collection-indexes tool to determine the index name.
- The `$search` stage supports multiple operators, such as 'autocomplete', 'text', 'geoWithin', and others. Choose the appropriate operator based on the user's query. If unsure of the exact syntax, consult the MongoDB Atlas Search documentation, which can be found here: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/operators-and-collectors/

### Usage Rules for `$rankFusion` and `$scoreFusion` (Hybrid Search)
Use these stages when the user wants to combine full-text (`$search`) and vector
(`$vectorSearch`) retrieval into a single fused result set. **Prefer native
fusion over a `$unionWith` + `$group` workaround** — the workaround averages
incompatible score scales and produces wrong rankings.

**Which stage to use:**
- `$rankFusion` (MongoDB 8.0+) — Reciprocal Rank Fusion. The recommended default.
  Normalizes scores across incompatible scales automatically. No score tuning needed.
- `$scoreFusion` (MongoDB 8.2+) — Score-based fusion. Use when the user needs explicit
  per-pipeline weights, score normalisation (sigmoid / minMaxScaler), or a custom
  combination expression.

**Construction rules:**
- `$rankFusion` / `$scoreFusion` MUST be the first stage of the top-level pipeline.
- Sub-pipelines go inside `input.pipelines` as a named map (not an array). Each name
  must be non-empty, must not start with `$`, and must not contain `.` or null bytes.
- Allowed stages inside sub-pipelines: `$search`, `$vectorSearch`, `$match`, `$sort`,
  `$geoNear`, `$skip`, `$limit`. `$project` and `$unset` are NOT allowed inside sub-pipelines.
- Do field shaping (`$project` / `$unset`) only AFTER the fusion stage, at the root.
- Both a vectorSearch (or autoEmbed) index AND a search (lexical) index must exist on
  the collection. Use the collection-indexes tool to confirm both before running a hybrid query.
- Add a `$limit` stage after the fusion stage to cap the final result set.
- Add `$unset` at the end to remove embedding fields and avoid context bloat.

### Usage Rules for `$rerank` (Native Reranking)
Use this stage when the user wants to reorder a set of candidate documents using a cross-encoder reranker model.

**Construction rules:**
- `$rerank` can be any stage in the pipeline on an Atlas cluster running MongoDB 8.3 or higher.
- It is recommended to use `$rerank` after a sorted pipeline, e.g. `$search`, `$vectorSearch`, `$rankFusion`, `$scoreFusion`, or [`$match`, `$sort`].
- $rerank must be enabled via the Native Reranking Project Setting
- Set `numDocsToRerank` as the number of documents passed into `$rerank`. This will also limit the number of documents returned by `$rerank`
- Set `path` as a field name or an array of field names that exist in all documents. Use `$match` or `$set` before `$rerank` to validate no fields are missing.
- Add `$addFields` after `$rerank` to retrieve the reranker score.

**`$rerank` example (recommended default):**
```javascript
[
  {
    $match: {
      description: { $exists: true },
      name: { $exists: true }
    }
  },
  {
    $sort: {
      lastUpdated: -1
    }
  },
  {
    $rerank: {
      query: {
        text: "query text including instructions"
      },
      model: "rerank-2.5",
      numDocsToRerank: 100,
      path: ["description", "name"]
    }
  },
  {
    $addFields: {
      rerankScore: { $meta: "score" }
    }
  }
]
```

oneOf.description:
Definition for a field containing source text from which embeddings will be automatically generated and managed by MongoDB at indexing time. Use this type when you want MongoDB to handle all embedding generation and storage internally. If the user specifies a dedicated field name for storing embeddings, use 'vector' type instead.

Auto-embedding facts (cover every point when answering):
- Availability: every Atlas tier (M0, Flex, dedicated), coupled or decoupled architecture, on AWS, GCP and Azure; no dedicated cluster needed. Inference runs on GCP in the US, so AWS and Azure clusters pay cross-cloud transfer, even within free tokens.
- Billing: free tokens are per Atlas Organization, shared by indexing and queries across all indexes and models; then billed per token.
- Query rate limits (separate from the free-token pool; indexing limits are internal and unrelated): per cluster and per model, in RPM and TPM, shared by that model's indexes; not per index or project, no auto-scaling. An M0 without a payment method is Tier 0 (lowest); adding one moves it to Tier 1 (voyage-4 ~8M TPM / 2k RPM, voyage-4-lite ~16M TPM / 2k RPM). On errors: backoff and retry, check the Atlas auto-embedding dashboard, request more via a support ticket. Never suggest bring-your-own embeddings.
- Shrinking: (1) quantization lowers precision per number: float (default, full precision, largest), scalar (smaller, some loss), binary (much smaller, rescored), binaryNoRescore (no rescoring, lower ranking quality); (2) numDimensions shortens each vector: only 256, 512, 1024 (default) or 2048; fewer means less storage and relevance; (3) both combine; test on real queries; (4) either change rebuilds the index with per-token re-embedding, though queries stay the same; (5) later changes need the user's agreement on settings and cost.
- Atlas supports quantization and numDimensions on autoEmbed fields, but this tool and MongoDB Community reject them: never drop an index to try them; leave it and show the Atlas definition.
- Changing the model or fields also rebuilds and re-embeds, billed per token.

fields.description: Definitions for the vector, autoEmbed and filter fields to index, one definition per document. Use 'vector' when user specifies a dedicated field that could contain vector embeddings. Use 'autoEmbed' when user wants MongoDB to automatically generate and manage embeddings internally from a text field (no separate embeddings field). Use 'filter' for additional fields to filter on. At least one 'vector' or 'autoEmbed' type field definition is required. If the user asks only for semantic search without saying who produces the embeddings (MongoDB: 'autoEmbed'; they: 'vector'), don't create the index: explain both and ask. For keyword plus semantic (hybrid) setup, use 'autoEmbed' without asking.

analyzer.description: The analyzer to use for the index. Can be one of the built-in lucene analyzers (`lucene.standard`, `lucene.simple`, `lucene.whitespace`, `lucene.keyword`), a language-specific analyzer, such as `lucene.cjk` or `lucene.czech`, or a custom analyzer defined by name in `analyzers`.

dynamic.description: Enables or disables dynamic mapping of fields for this index. If set to true, Atlas Search recursively indexes all dynamically indexable fields. If set to false, you must specify individual fields to index using mappings.fields. Can also be set to `{ typeSet: '<name>' }` to reference a named entry in this index's `typeSets`, restricting dynamic mapping to only the field types listed in that type set.

additionalProperties.description: The field index definition. It must contain the field type (e.g. `{ type: 'string' }`), as well as any additional options for that field type (e.g. `analyzer`). Field types include `autocomplete`, `boolean`, `date`, `dateFacet`, `document`, `embeddedDocuments`, `geo`, `number`, `numberFacet`, `objectId`, `string`, `stringFacet`, `token`, `uuid`. Provide an array of field definitions instead of a single object to index the same field as multiple types, e.g. `[{ type: 'string' }, { type: 'autocomplete' }]`.

mappings.description: Document describing the index to create. `fields` is required and must define at least one field when `dynamic` is `false` (the default). When `dynamic` is `true` or a typeSet object, `fields` may still be provided to index additional fields explicitly.

oneOf.description:
Definition for an Atlas Search (lexical) index. Use this only if user explicitly asked for creating an Atlas search index or simply a search index.

This definition also accepts the following top-level fields, which are forwarded as-is and are not exhaustively typed here:
- `analyzers`: array of custom analyzer definitions, e.g. `{ name: 'myAnalyzer', tokenizer: { type: 'standard' }, tokenFilters: [{ type: 'lowercase' }], charFilters: [{ type: 'htmlStrip' }] }`. Reference a custom analyzer by its `name` from a field's `analyzer`/`searchAnalyzer` option, instead of a built-in `lucene.*` analyzer. Tokenizer types include `standard`, `keyword`, `whitespace`, `nGram`, `edgeGram`, `regexSplit`, `regexCaptureGroup`, `uaxUrlEmail`. Token filter types include `lowercase`, `stopword`, `snowballStemming`, `asciiFolding`, `nGram`, `shingle`, `trim`, among others.
- `synonyms`: array of synonym mappings, e.g. `{ name: 'mySynonyms', source: { collection: 'synonymsCollectionName' }, analyzer: 'lucene.standard' }`. The `analyzer` should match the analyzer used on the field(s) being searched.
- `storedSource`: controls which fields are stored on search nodes for fast retrieval without a round trip to the database. `true` stores all fields, `false` (default) stores none, `{ include: ['fieldA', 'fieldB'] }` stores only the listed fields, `{ exclude: ['fieldC'] }` stores all except the listed fields.
- `typeSets`: array of named field-type sets for use with `mappings.dynamic`, e.g. `{ name: 'myTypeSet', types: [{ type: 'string' }, { type: 'number' }] }`, to restrict dynamic mapping to only the listed types instead of every dynamically indexable type.

  If the user requests additional filtering, include filters in `$vectorSearch.filter` only for pre-filter fields in the vector index.
  NEVER include fields in $vectorSearch.filter that are not part of the vector index.
- **Post-filtering:**
  For all remaining filters, add a $match stage after $vectorSearch.
- If unsure which fields are filterable, use the collection-indexes tool to determine valid prefilter fields.
- If no requested filters are valid prefilters, omit the filter key from $vectorSearch.

### Usage Rules for `$search`
- Include the index name, unless you know for a fact there's a default index. If unsure, use the collection-indexes tool to determine the index name.
- The `$search` stage supports multiple operators, such as 'autocomplete', 'text', 'geoWithin', and others. Choose the appropriate operator based on the user's query. If unsure of the exact syntax, consult the MongoDB Atlas Search documentation, which can be found here: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/operators-and-collectors/

### Usage Rules for `$rankFusion` and `$scoreFusion` (Hybrid Search)
Use these stages when the user wants to combine full-text (`$search`) and vector
(`$vectorSearch`) retrieval into a single fused result set. **Prefer native
fusion over a `$unionWith` + `$group` workaround** — the workaround averages
incompatible score scales and produces wrong rankings.

**Which stage to use:**
- `$rankFusion` (MongoDB 8.0+) — Reciprocal Rank Fusion. The recommended default.
  Normalizes scores across incompatible scales automatically. No score tuning needed.
- `$scoreFusion` (MongoDB 8.2+) — Score-based fusion. Use when the user needs explicit
  per-pipeline weights, score normalisation (sigmoid / minMaxScaler), or a custom
  combination expression.

**Construction rules:**
- `$rankFusion` / `$scoreFusion` MUST be the first stage of the top-level pipeline.
- Sub-pipelines go inside `input.pipelines` as a named map (not an array). Each name
  must be non-empty, must not start with `$`, and must not contain `.` or null bytes.
- Allowed stages inside sub-pipelines: `$search`, `$vectorSearch`, `$match`, `$sort`,
  `$geoNear`, `$skip`, `$limit`. `$project` and `$unset` are NOT allowed inside sub-pipelines.
- Do field shaping (`$project` / `$unset`) only AFTER the fusion stage, at the root.
- Both a vectorSearch (or autoEmbed) index AND a search (lexical) index must exist on
  the collection. Use the collection-indexes tool to confirm both before running a hybrid query.
- Add a `$limit` stage after the fusion stage to cap the final result set.
- Add `$unset` at the end to remove embedding fields and avoid context bloat.

### Usage Rules for `$rerank` (Native Reranking)
Use this stage when the user wants to reorder a set of candidate documents using a cross-encoder reranker model.

**Construction rules:**
- `$rerank` can be any stage in the pipeline on an Atlas cluster running MongoDB 8.3 or higher.
- It is recommended to use `$rerank` after a sorted pipeline, e.g. `$search`, `$vectorSearch`, `$rankFusion`, `$scoreFusion`, or [`$match`, `$sort`].
- $rerank must be enabled via the Native Reranking Project Setting
- Set `numDocsToRerank` as the number of documents passed into `$rerank`. This will also limit the number of documents returned by `$rerank`
- Set `path` as a field name or an array of field names that exist in all documents. Use `$match` or `$set` before `$rerank` to validate no fields are missing.
- Add `$addFields` after `$rerank` to retrieve the reranker score.

**`$rerank` example (recommended default):**
```javascript
[
  {
    $match: {
      description: { $exists: true },
      name: { $exists: true }
    }
  },
  {
    $sort: {
      lastUpdated: -1
    }
  },
  {
    $rerank: {
      query: {
        text: "query text including instructions"
      },
      model: "rerank-2.5",
      numDocsToRerank: 100,
      path: ["description", "name"]
    }
  },
  {
    $addFields: {
      rerankScore: { $meta: "score" }
    }
  }
]
```

definition.name: browser_eval
definition.description:
Set up and use browser automation for this project via the agent-browser CLI.

This tool does NOT drive the browser itself. It points you at `agent-browser` — a fast, native browser-automation CLI built for agents (https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser) — and tells you how to install it (if needed) and where to start. You then run its commands directly (you have shell access), which is faster and more capable than proxying automation through MCP.

Call this when you need to open pages, click, type, screenshot, or capture console errors in a real browser.

definition.name: nextjs_call
definition.description:
Call a specific MCP tool on a running Next.js development server.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Port number of the target Next.js dev server
- Tool name to execute
- Optional arguments object (if the tool requires parameters)

Use 'nextjs_index' first to discover available servers, tools, and their input schemas.
If 'nextjs_index' auto-discovery fails, ask the user for the port and call 'nextjs_index' again with the 'port' parameter.

IMPORTANT: When calling tools:
- The 'args' parameter MUST be an object (e.g., {key: "value"}), NOT a string
- If a tool doesn't require arguments, OMIT the 'args' parameter entirely - do NOT pass {} or "{}"
- Check the tool's inputSchema from 'nextjs_index' to see what arguments are required

Common Next.js MCP tools include:
- Error diagnostics (get compilation/runtime errors)
- Route information (list all routes)
- Build status (check compilation state)
- Cache management (clear caches)
- And more (varies by Next.js version)

Example usage:
1. Call 'nextjs_index' to see servers and tools
2. Call 'nextjs_call' with port=3000, toolName="get_errors" to get errors from server on port 3000

port.description: Port number of the Next.js dev server (required).

toolName.description: Name of the Next.js MCP tool to call (required). Use 'nextjs_index' first to discover available tool names.

definition.name: nextjs_docs
definition.description:
Find the version-accurate Next.js documentation for THIS project.

This tool does NOT fetch documentation. Next.js 16+ ships its full docs inside the installed package at `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` (markdown), kept in sync with the exact version you have installed. This tool tells you where those docs are and how to read them — so you read the docs that match this project, not a generic or outdated copy.

Call this before answering Next.js questions or writing Next.js code. Then read the relevant guide from the path it returns. If the project is on an older Next.js, it will tell you how to upgrade.

definition.name: nextjs_index
definition.description:
Discover all running Next.js development servers and list their available MCP tools.

WHEN TO USE THIS TOOL - Use proactively in these scenarios:

1. **Before implementing ANY changes to the app**: When asked to add, modify, or fix anything in the application:
   - "Add a loading state" → Check current component structure and routes first
   - "Fix the navigation" → Inspect existing routes and components
   - "Update the API endpoint" → Query current routes and data flows
   - "Add error handling" → Check runtime errors and component hierarchy
   - "Refactor the auth logic" → Inspect current auth implementation and routes
   - "Optimize performance" → Check runtime diagnostics and component tree
   Use this to understand where changes should be made and what currently exists.

2. **For diagnostic and investigation questions**:
   - "What's happening?" / "What's going on?" / "Why isn't this working?"
   - "Check the errors" / "See what's wrong"
   - "What routes are available?" / "Show me the routes"
   - "Clear the cache" / "Reset everything"
   - Questions about build status, compilation errors, or runtime diagnostics

3. **For agentic codebase search**: Use this as FIRST CHOICE for searching the currently running app. If not found, fallback to static codebase search tools.

KEY PRINCIPLE: If the request involves the running Next.js application (whether to investigate OR modify it), query the runtime FIRST to understand current state before proceeding.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Next.js 16 or later (MCP support was added in v16)
- If you're on Next.js 15 or earlier, upgrade first by running 'npx @next/codemod@latest upgrade latest'

Next.js 16+ exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint at /_next/mcp automatically when the dev server starts.
No configuration needed - MCP is enabled by default in Next.js 16 and later.

This tool discovers all running Next.js servers and returns:
- Server port, PID, and URL
- Complete list of available MCP tools for each server
- Tool descriptions and input schemas

After calling this tool, use 'nextjs_call' to execute specific tools.

[IMPORTANT] If auto-discovery returns no servers:
1. Ask the user which port their Next.js dev server is running on
2. Call this tool again with the 'port' parameter set to the user-provided port

If the MCP endpoint is not available:
1. Ensure you're running Next.js 16 or later (upgrade with 'npx @next/codemod@latest upgrade latest')
2. Verify the dev server is running (npm run dev)

definition.name: analyze_function
definition.title: Analyze Function
definition.description: Build a dossier for one native function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns identity with complete inclusive analyzed body ranges or explicit unknown, provider-specific pseudocode and assembly, comments, calls, references, referenced strings/names, local CFG blocks, and available native API boundary observations. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in limitations with available callee identities. Default detail summary returns a compact dossier (identity, pseudocode size, facet counts, value-flow availability) and retains the complete dossier Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references, assembly and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. detail complete returns the full dossier inline.

definition.name: analyze_javascript_application
definition.title: Analyze Javascript Application
definition.description: Reconstruct one local ASAR or extracted JavaScript application as an inline application graph without executing it. Returns recovered graph nodes, edges, semantic relations, integrity contradictions, limitations, and coverage. Select source_paths to acquire and analyze only exact inventoried file paths; the complete artifact inventory and identity remain intact, and unselected sources remain explicit unknowns. Dependencies are not implicitly analyzed. Select detail summary to retain the complete analysis Evidence in this session and receive only its summary view, then inspect selected modules or pages with inspect_analysis_view. Select a javascript-routes view with summary detail to query deduplicated static patterns, source-linked occurrences, source status or interpretation gaps with filters, fields and paging. Static routes do not establish reachability or the full application route set. Summary detail reduces delivery, whereas source_paths bounds source analysis. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue retains observed bytes as untrusted and marks graph coverage partial. Timeout recovery: returned provider_timeout uses the per-source analysis_timeout_ms budget. A host-only 'timed out awaiting tools/call' needs a longer client tool deadline, not a larger analysis_timeout_ms. Never repeat the unchanged call to test whether that timeout persists; report the host setting if configuration is not editable (Codex: mcp_servers.<server>.tool_timeout_sec, seconds).

input_path.description: Absolute path to the JavaScript application on the machine running REA.

format.description: Declared input artifact format.

source_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

max_semantic_nodes.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes across the application; defaults to 100000. Worker heap and parent result admission remain enforced.

max_semantic_nodes_per_file.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes per source file; defaults to 20000, additionally bounded by max_semantic_nodes and memory/transfer limits.

max_semantic_unknowns.description: Maximum retained semantic unknown records across the application; defaults to 100000. Omitted emission occurrences are counted by family and reason.

max_semantic_unknowns_per_file.description: Maximum retained semantic unknown records per source file; defaults to 20000, additionally bounded by max_semantic_unknowns and memory/transfer limits.

max_heap_mb.description: Maximum V8 old-space heap in MiB for the isolated JavaScript source analyzer; defaults to 1024. This does not change the CLI/MCP process heap. When REA runs on Bun, which ignores V8 heap flags, Windows instead limits the analyzer's committed memory to this budget plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve; other Bun hosts enforce no limit.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Maximum startup, analysis and transfer time per JavaScript source, in milliseconds; defaults to 300000. On timeout, return collected partial Evidence and stop the analysis.

inputSchema.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

path_prefix.description: Exact string prefix; no URL/path normalization.

requested_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

node_id.description: SHA-256 of the node kind and identity; stable for one artifact version.

__schema83.description: One-based lines, zero-based UTF-16 columns; start inclusive, end exclusive.

relation_id.description: SHA-256 of the exact relation content, including its evidence reference.

path.description: Selected artifact path, or the canonical resource root when resource-only Evidence has no executable subject.

definition.name: analyze_swift_types
definition.title: Analyze Swift Types
definition.description: Categorize analyzed Swift procedure names using their manglings or same-address Swift symbol aliases. Decodes legacy and literal modern nominal contexts into classes, structs, enums, protocols, and extensions. Preserves provider names and supporting mangled_names; unresolved categories appear in other and in unclassified, which remains inline even under category filters. Returns deduplicated procedure-name counts, not unique source types, plus identification limitations. Optionally select one category and/or apply a case-sensitive literal filter to provider names or supporting manglings; for example, use {category: "structs", pattern: "Pair"}.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

definition.name: analyze_web_bundle
definition.title: Analyze Web Bundle
definition.description: Capture JavaScript source from one selected CDP page and statically derive a chunk graph, route and endpoint candidates, vendor fingerprints, page-declared WebMCP metadata, and optionally fetch source maps from the selected target origin or explicitly requested origins. JavaScript is parsed but never executed. Select detail summary and an explicit javascript-routes view for filtered route patterns, occurrences, sources, unknowns or summary counts; complete Evidence remains retained for later views. Static candidates do not establish reachability or a complete application route denominator.

cdp_endpoint.description: Literal loopback CDP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:PORT, or ws://127.0.0.1:PORT/devtools/browser/ID.

target_id.description: Exact CDP target identifier selected from the endpoint's target listing.

command_timeout_ms.description: CDP WebSocket handshake and per-command response deadline in milliseconds (default 20000). Omitted means 20000 and applies on the next call. deadlineExpired for a handshake or command is not the caller observation window, not the 10000 ms CDP discovery response deadline, and not the 5000 ms cleanup grace. It also bounds passive script-source collection and the inspection/source-join phase that share this deadline. Does not raise the fixed protocol, retained-event, or source byte budgets. CDP discovery and cleanup grace have no runtime override.

include_accessibility_text.description: Whether to include accessibility text in the result.

include_console_text.description: Whether to include console text in the result.

include_json_body_shapes.description: Whether to include json body shapes in the result.

include_websocket_shapes.description: Whether to include websocket shapes in the result.

include_storage_keys.description: Whether to include storage keys in the result.

include_storage_fingerprints.description: Whether to include storage fingerprints in the result.

include_script_sources.description: Whether to include script sources in the result.

max_heap_mb.description: Heap phase: maximum V8 old-space for the isolated inert-script analyzer, in MiB (default 1024, range 128..16384). Omitted means 1024 and applies on the next call. This is not a total process RSS limit, not analysis_timeout_ms, and not total_analysis_timeout_ms. Bun ignores V8 flags; Windows Bun uses an owned process commit limit plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve, while other Bun hosts have no enforced memory limit. Raising max_heap_mb does not raise the fixed worker protocol or result byte budgets.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Per-script deadline phase: maximum startup, analysis and result transfer time for one captured script, in milliseconds (default 30000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 30000. deadlineExpired for one script is not total_analysis_timeout_ms. A per-script value above the effective total is rejected. Timed-out scripts are explicit unknowns and other scripts may still be analyzed. Applies on the next call.

total_analysis_timeout_ms.description: Total analysis deadline phase: maximum time for all captured-script analysis, in milliseconds (default 300000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 300000. This is not the per-script analysis_timeout_ms, not capture, and not source-map fetch. A per-script timeout above this total is rejected. Unstarted scripts remain explicit unknowns. Native export tables use kind native-exports, collection exports/issues, exact names or original indices, selected fields and matching-row pagination; parent Evidence plus source_index identifies each row. BEAM views use kind beam, collections atoms/exports/imports/lambdas/chunks, exact names/indices/fields and matching-row pages; import modules intersects function names. source_index identifies original parent-and-collection rows, preserving every arity and raw atom index. beam.counts preserves null missing tables versus decoded empty tables; runtime absence remains unknown. Templates, parameters and names are inferences; the view copies no header, cookie or body values and refuses parents inspected with sensitive values. A capture_browser_scenario parent that selected response bodies or header values projects the same way, one record per network transaction in request order; it relies on capture-time redaction of declared secrets instead of that refusal, and a transaction whose URL was redacted is left unrepresented. The environment-state view extracts, from the same parents, the initial state the recorded reads observed: view {kind: "environment-state", template_rules: [...]} with the rules of the manifest it accompanies. It reads response bodies recorded before the first related write and reports entity types with an identity field (proved by a path parameter or inferred from a field name), entities in collection order with per-view values where views differ, documents for non-parameterized reads that are not entities and have one initial request line (item-shaped paths stay recorded), and a render plan per read tool: item and list views reproduce their latest recordings from the state (a list also learns the filters, search, sort and paging its recordings verify, and answers new values of them from the state), and every other read tool is a recorded view with a reason. It also reports a write plan per state-changing tool (create, update, delete or document, built from its first successful call) and write_clock; a plan is served only when replaying the capture shows a later read confirming its effect and none contradicting it. Types and identity are inferences; values are recorded data, so it refuses parents inspected with sensitive values, and a scenario parent must have selected response bodies; its values keep the capture redaction markers, and a write whose URL it redacted ends the state of every type. The environment-coverage view, view {kind: "environment-coverage", template_rules: [...]}, summarizes that state without its entities: reads.state and reads.recorded count read tools answered from the state and replayed (recorded_reasons per view reason), writes.served lists the served write tools, and writes.withheld lists each other write tool with its reason, plan record, contradicting read and a hint about what to record next; it refuses what the environment-state view refuses. For a retained record use source: {kind: "retained-evidence", evidence_id: "<parent_evidence_id>"}. Use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id from a summary receipt. Source kind is required. Portable source uses {kind: "inline", evidence: <complete Evidence>}. A completed Evidence JSON file on this host uses {kind: "evidence-file", path: "<absolute path>"}: REA reads and authenticates it, then projects it like retained Evidence, so a large capture is bounded by the file reader rather than by inline-input accounting. The file may also be an Evidence bundle written by CLI --evidence_output or export_evidence_bundle; select evidence_id when it contains more than one record. For layout, JavaScript, inventory, WASM, Mach-O, Interface Builder, EVM, managed artifact, Android package and Dart AOT sources, request a summary with view: {kind: "summary"}; summary is a view kind and has no facet. The WASM summary gives validation, counts, WAT digest/length, tool profile and execution/network states without reading WAT text. Select a layout mitigations/linkage facet, one section/symbol/module, or a stable page. Module pages include assets, bundled and source modules; use node_id for ambiguous or unavailable paths. Typed module references use view {kind: "javascript", collection: "modules", projection: "references", where: {path: "main.js", kind: "javascript-module"}, offset: 0, limit: 64}; where matches exact retained strings (null selects unavailable paths). Rows include canonical identity, retained source-range count and observation support states. Source coverage and selection remain explicit; exhausting matching rows does not prove runtime loading or complete analysis. For exact file/native facts and processing gaps, use view {kind: "javascript-facts", where: {paths: ["package.json"]}, property_keys: ["name", "operation", "analysis_status"]}. Rows page original observations with canonical identities and Evidence; missing properties remain omitted. Paths match recorded artifact-path/source-range locations; optional kinds filter nodes. To discover field names without values, opt into include_available_property_keys: true with property_keys: []. Canonical identity and Evidence are separate from properties; keep each node_id/observation_id pair together when composing results. Inventory uses view: {kind: "inventory", collection: "occurrences", logical_paths: ["package.json"], offset: 0, limit: 64}. Inventory views page nodes, occurrences, edges or integrity contradictions. Occurrences accept exact logical_paths and occurrence_ids; nodes accept artifact_ids. Batch filters intersect (omitted means all available, [] means none); fields selects columns while retaining identity links. source_complete describes retained graph membership; source_coverage describes producer coverage, including unknown encrypted PCK directories. Page exhaustion does not prove absence in a partial source. WASM views use kind wasm and facet sections/imports/exports/candidates/glue/wat/headers/details/tool_profile; text facets use UTF-16 code units and source forms remain exact. Mach-O views use kind macho and facet entrypoints/architectures/build_metadata/load_commands/dependencies/imports/exports/segments/provenance; source_exhaustive false means unreturned rows may exist. Interface Builder views use kind interface-builder and collection documents/nodes/edges/coverage; nodes and edges accept an exact document relative_path. EVM summary returns all inferred interface candidates, carrier/decoded identities and explicit unknowns without hex or duplicate stdout. EVM views use kind evm and facet functions/bytecode_hex/stdout/stderr; function pages preserve the original candidate rows, and text offsets/limits count UTF-16 code units (hex has two characters per decoded byte). Exhausting candidate pages does not establish global interface completeness. Managed artifact summaries preserve complete identity/classification, metadata status, module/MVID, frameworks, coverage and limitations without unrelated inventories. Managed pages use kind managed and collection references/resources/attributes, retaining source coverage and build-local token scope; page exhaustion does not establish complete metadata. Managed member summaries keep identity, selection with unmatched names, coverage and per-collection counts; managed-members pages use collection types/exported_types/fields/methods/member_refs/call_edges/field_accesses/user_strings and carry the source selection and coverage. Android package summaries retain all declarations, engine identity and counts without decoded manifest text. Android manifest pages use kind android, facet manifest, offset and limit in UTF-16 code units; source_status preserves partial decoded coverage even when the retained text page is exhausted. Dart AOT summary preserves target/ABI/library identity, snapshot headers and pool lower bounds. String pages use kind dart-aot, collection package_uris/dart_uris/class_like_tokens; source coverage remains partial when the producer says partial. Protobuf views use kind protobuf, collection bodies/frames/fields, with record_ordinals, body_pointers and fields; field pages also select frame_indices, field_ids, field_numbers or schema_names. Byte identity, offset basis and body status remain present. Text and schema_value are opt-in page columns. APK signing views use kind apk-signature and collection signers/digests/lineage, with ids, signer_ids, schemes, fields and paging. Identity links remain when fields is empty. Declared identities and digest matches do not establish signature verification or authenticity. Model views use kind model-artifact and collection metadata (keys), tensors (names/types) or types (derived totals), with indices, fields and paging. Header SHA-256 scopes declarations; full-file identity remains unknown unless full hashing was selected. Arrays retain typed eight-element previews with explicit omissions. IL2CPP metadata views use kind il2cpp-metadata and collection sections/images/types/methods/fields/properties/events/parameters/string_literals/code_gen_modules/method_addresses/return_types/field_types/parameter_types/generic_method_instances/generic_method_issues. Select indices, fields and pages; sections/images/types/methods/fields/properties/events/parameters/return_types/field_types/parameter_types/generic_method_instances accept exact names (native type names match retained rendered values, preserving same-name rows; null names never match), types also accept image_indices/namespaces/declaring_types, and methods/members accept declaring_types. Parameters and parameter_types accept method_indices; code_gen_modules accept image_indices; method_addresses and generic_method_instances accept addresses/states (generic_method_instances also method_indices), preserving every folded alternative; generic_method_issues accept rows. Row index is scoped to the metadata digest; native pages add binary_source. Uncollected native tables have null counts and remain unavailable. Desktop directory views use kind desktop-application and collection files/omissions/candidates/components/next_probes, with fields and pagination; files and omissions accept exact paths or their stable IDs, and candidates accept families. Source coverage and stable row IDs remain available. Native inventory Evidence from list_names, list/search_procedures or list/search_strings uses view: {kind: "native-inventory", offset: 0, limit: 64, fields: ["value"]}. Rows keep source_index and address even with selected fields. Summary counts describe retained rows; provider discovery coverage remains unknown. Native function Evidence accepts kind summary for identity, availability and facet counts, or kind native for selected facts: view: {kind: "native", facet: "procedure"}. Facets select procedure, pseudocode, assembly, basic blocks, comments, callers/callees, references, unresolved calls, referenced strings/names, native API and high-pcode. Use nonnegative offset and a positive caller-selected limit (defaults 0 and 64); pseudocode uses UTF-16 code units, other native pages use rows. Returns artifact identity, parent Evidence ID, a distinct view digest, coverage, limitations and unknowns. Actual serialized size determines MCP transport admission; choose a smaller page or export the complete retained Evidence if needed.

origin.description: Primary origin: the origin with the most JSON-like records.

api_surface_template.description: Four-rule template of the tool's earliest record.

template_rules.description: Opt-in template rules applied after the four format rules, each listed at most once: after-uid-literal templates the segment following a literal uid, opaque-token templates long mixed alphanumeric segments, sibling-variance merges groups that differ in one identifier-like segment, sibling-pair-variance merges groups that differ in two adjacent literals between a plural literal and another literal when at least three distinct pairs vary in both, prefix-variance templates a literal at a position another tool templates by one of the other opt-in rules after the same preceding segments, at any method or length, when the literal is one of that parameter's observed values, carries a digit and has the length and character classes of one, or has the single length (eight or more characters) every observed value has and only their character classes. init_before_ordinal.description: First recorded write whose path root relates to the type; state comes from records that finished before it.

volatile_fields.description: Fields whose recorded values changed with no recorded write between; the state keeps the latest.

entities.description: Entities in collection order: type, collection, then first sighting.

envelope_ordinal.description: Record whose response, with the entity object replaced, every item response shares.

membership.description: all: every entity of the collection in state order; recorded: the entities each recorded response listed, except on the lines all_record_ordinals names.

all_record_ordinals.description: With recorded membership, the checked lines that each listed every entity of their collection in state order, with only paging parameters starting at zero; a call answered on one lists the whole collection. Absent when none does.

counters.description: Envelope members that count the listed entities: a top-level member's name, or a JSON pointer to one in a top-level object beside the list (`/pageInfo/totalRows`); a top-level name starting with `/` is written as its pointer (`/~1total`).

query.description: How the view's other checked lines select and order entities, when filters, a search, a sort or paging explain them; absent when none does.

writes.description: One plan per tool whose method may change state: its modelled effect, and whether the capture's later reads confirmed it (served).

write_clock.description: The instant a served clock starts from: the end of the capture's last timed record.

state.description: Read tools answered from the state.

recorded.description: Read tools that replay their recordings.

recorded_reasons.description: Replayed read tools per reason, as the environment-state view names the reasons.

hint.description: What to record next; advice that never changes what is served.

exemplar_ordinal.description: The first successful recorded call the plan was built from.

contradicted_by.description: The read that disagreed with the modelled effect.

template_rules.description: Opt-in template rules as for environment-manifest, each listed at most once. Use the rules of the manifest the environment serves so tool names match.

mi.description: The console command's independently framed MI result record; empty when a separate read-only query proves completion but raw stdout prevents identifying the original result class.

limitations: This Evidence predates the manifest component projection; run inspect_android_package again to obtain it.

code_units.description: Pseudocode length in UTF-16 code units, the unit inspect_analysis_view pages pseudocode by.

truncated.description: True only when value-flow is available and the provider truncated it; false when value-flow is unavailable (see available).

provider_value.description: Original provider display text, which may shorten the typed object.

decoding.description: When present, value retains native display text because typed bytes could not be decoded.

fields.description: Original index always retained. Default attributes omit dependency vectors; select dependencies explicitly for direct index references.

enclosing_type_token.description: Observed enclosing TypeDef from NestedClass; null when no enclosing entry was available, which alone does not establish top-level identity.

il_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the raw il_size CIL bytes; excludes the method header, locals signature, alignment, and extra sections

class_type_identity_resolved.description: Whether this artifact's local token identifies the reported catch type; null when unexamined

target_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the called method; null when unknown

target_identity_sha256.description: Nominal declaring-type/name/signature digest; null when unresolved or unrecorded. Does not establish assembly or runtime binding.

field_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the accessed field; null when unknown

value.description: Decoded UTF-16 code units, excluding the terminal flag byte; unpaired surrogates are kept

__schema118.description: Latest init record per request line that the view reproduced from the state.

__schema122.description: How the view spells clock fields it always spells otherwise than the entities' stored values; a stored value the view never recorded is spelled this way.

parameters.description: What each query parameter does. A call whose every parameter has a role is answered by evaluating them over the state.

record_ordinals.description: Checked lines the query reproduces, answered by evaluating it.

totals.description: Observed envelope members with reproducible counts of every match before paging, named as counters are; absent or unknown representations stay recorded.

field.description: Entities whose field equals the value as text, or whose array field holds it directly or as an object's id, slug or name.

fields.description: Entities with a string field containing a plain substring value, ignoring case using Unicode simple case folding; an empty value matches every entity. Syntax-like operators replay instead.

asc or desc for the sort parameter.

first.description: The first page, 0 or 1, when recordings distinguish the convention.

values.description: Recorded values that change nothing the view lists; other values are not computed.

target.description: The entity type an entity effect writes, or the document view a document write changes.

exemplar_ordinal.description: The first successful recorded call the plan was built from.

observation.description: The record whose response showed the written entity or document, and a JSON pointer to it.

body.description: Body members the application stored as sent (accepted), members accepted only with their recorded value (fixed), members every call sends (required), the JSON type a later call stored an accepted member as when the observation does not show it (kinds), the member a call wraps its object in as a one-element array (envelope), and the value a create stores for an accepted member a call leaves out, as a call that left it out showed (defaults).

collection.description: For a create whose recorded values are tied to its collection, the only collection it writes to.

checked_record_ordinals.description: Later reads that reproduced from the state after this write.

read.description: A create's later read of the entity: an item read lends fields the response lacks and its clock spellings, a list read only adds fields the response lacks.

requested_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

Read the exact retained manifest with view kind android, facet manifest, offset and limit (UTF-16 code units), using normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. definition.title: Inspect Apk Signature
definition.description: Inspect declared v1/v2/v3/v3.1 APK signers, certificate fingerprints, algorithm IDs, content digests, SDK ranges, rotation lineage and source stamp without executing Android code. SHA-256 identifies the exact local file. Summary retains complete Evidence; an optional view selects signers/digests/lineage using stable IDs, scheme or signer-ID batches, fields and paging. Read retained pages with inspect_analysis_view kind apk-signature after the source is removed. IDs include artifact digest, scheme and source ordinal; certificates retain raw-DER SHA-256. Content-digest equality is not cryptographic signature verification: modified declarations can match modified bytes. Authenticity, signatures, lineage trust and v1 entry coverage remain unverified. Malformed structures and resource refusals are explicit; no device, network or SDK is used by REA.

Other bug_type values, including 288 stackshots, return no crash result. A missing or truncated body fails without partial success. Opened Mach-O and dSYM UUID joins remain unobserved. definition.name: inspect_artifact
definition.title: Inspect Artifact
definition.description: Inspect an active archive or application package, including Node.js SEA carriers, in one call. By default returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph once, as the typed nested inventory Evidence, with root and integrity observations, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. For PCK and large containers prefer detail summary: it retains the complete inspection and returns its derived summary view; read exact paths, batch occurrence/content IDs and selected fields with inspect_analysis_view using parent_evidence_id. This changes delivery, not inventory coverage. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize regular contents of supported formats. DMG extraction is unavailable; use a caller-managed read-only mount on macOS to access its files.
